name: Med-HALT
intro: Med-HALT是专门用于评估大型语言模型在医疗领域幻觉问题的基准数据集，提供来自不同国家医疗检查的多样化数据，包含多种创新测试模式，涵盖推理和记忆幻觉两大类别。
build_method: 多国医学考试汇集、测试变换、PubMed文献配对
task_type: 医疗问答, 幻觉评测, 信息检索
eval_feature: 3类推理幻觉测试, 4类记忆幻觉测试
scale: 每项推理测试18,866个样本；每项记忆测试4,916个样本
task_type_en: Medical QA, hallucination evaluation, information retrieval
build_method_en: Multinational medical-exam aggregation, test transformations, PubMed article pairing
eval_feature_en: Three reasoning hallucination tests and four memory hallucination tests
intro_en: Med-HALT is a benchmark dataset specifically designed to evaluate hallucination issues of large language models in the medical field. It provides diverse data from medical examinations across different countries and includes various innovative testing modes, covering both reasoning and memory hallucination categories.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2307.15343, the CoNLL 2023 paper, and the official Med-HALT project page. The diagram preserves 9,515 Indian MedMCQA items, 4,068 Spanish HeadQA items, 2,801 US MedQA items, and 2,482 Taiwan MedQA items for 18,866 samples per reasoning test; 4,916 PubMed records per memory test; False Confidence, None of the Above, and hybrid human/GPT-3.5 Fake Question tests; Abstract-to-Link, PMID-to-Title, Title-to-Link, and Link-to-Title memory tests; the evaluated Text-Davinci/GPT-3.5/Llama-2/MPT/Falcon families; structured-output exception handling; binary correctness; and Accuracy plus Pointwise Score aggregation.
